content.short: TerraPay is a global payment network connecting banks, wallets and cards across more than 200 countries.
content.description: TerraPay moves remittances and business payments into bank accounts, mobile wallets and cards, and its reach into wallets is the unusual part, connecting billions of them in markets where wallet balances matter more than bank accounts. It sends from over 210 countries into roughly 144, holding licences in around 30 regulated markets. Founded in London in 2014, it serves banks, money transfer operators and merchants rather than consumers directly. It has since added stablecoin funded flows to cut the cost of prefunding destination markets.
